easyPrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
